author: agent:claude-code
message: Tend's graft 01a16034: a per-host flake output of the system services each host runs, for the estate's Machine sources (proposal 01a165ec-4e25-722f-97cd-cf5f5ddc6a85, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

text: The flake exposes `estate`: per host, the system services it runs and where it's hosted, read without building
why: Tend's estate (Machine sources) reads machines and their services from the repos that declare them; the user chose a small output over Tend walking each host's option tree. Each module that turns on a system service lists it in estate.services where it turns it on (openssh with tailnet_only and guests, tailscale, lact, tenstorrent, sddm with its sessions, networkmanager / wpa_supplicant, bluetooth, cups, yabai), so what counts as a service stays with the modules; vgwsl2 sets estate.hostedOn = vghydra. `nix eval --json nix#estate` answers all 7 hosts in ~10 s (checked).

text: A host imports hardware-configuration.nix only once it exists
why: Hosts not installed yet (vgnixmini, vgsquid-azul/onyx/jade) must still evaluate for the estate output; with the import filtered by builtins.pathExists they do, and a system build of one still fails clearly (the fileSystems assertion) instead of on a missing file. check-hosts.sh still reports them PENDING from git. vgkraken keeps the plain import: it has its file, so a lost one fails loudly.
